meta.project: Task Manager "Si No Lo Hace Llora"

product_overview: A web-based daily task manager that helps users organize tasks, track time with per-task countdown timers, and review productivity through charts and activity history. It also supports account access, category organization, Excel-based table workflows, themes, and an admin user view.
core_goals: Register and sign in to access a personalized task workspace
Create, update, complete, filter, and delete daily tasks
Organize tasks using categories and priority levels
Track work time on individual tasks with countdown timers
Review productivity through profile statistics, streaks, charts, and heatmaps
Manage tasks in a monthly table and exchange data with Excel files
Customize the app appearance with visual themes
Access a basic admin view for user information

features.name: User Registration
features.description: Allows a new user to create an account with name, email, and password.
user_flows: Navigate to /register -> Fill in name -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit the registration form -> See success message -> Go to /login

features.name: User Login
features.description: Allows a returning user to sign in with email and password.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit the login form -> See the authenticated experience

features.name: Task Management
features.description: Lets an authenticated user create tasks, mark them complete, edit them, delete them, and filter them by status.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open task creation -> Fill in task details including title, description, timer minutes, priority, and category -> Save the task -> See the new task in the list
Navigate to / -> Mark a task as completed -> See the task move to the completed state
Navigate to / -> Open task editing -> Update task details -> Save the changes -> See the task updated in the list
Navigate to / -> Delete a task -> See the task removed from the list
Navigate to / -> Remove completed tasks -> See completed tasks disappear from the list
Navigate to / -> Switch between all, active, and completed views -> See the list update to match the selected status

features.name: Task Timer
features.description: Lets an authenticated user run a countdown timer on a task and control it while it is running.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Start the timer on a task -> See the remaining time count down each second -> Receive sound and notification feedback when the timer ends
Navigate to / -> Start the timer on a task -> Pause the running timer -> Resume timer control by starting it again -> Stop and reset the timer

features.name: Category Management
features.description: Lets an authenticated user create, rename, recolor, and delete task categories.
user_flows: Navigate to /categories -> View the existing categories -> Add a new category name and color -> Save the category -> See it appear in the category list
Navigate to /categories -> Open category editing -> Change the category name or color -> Save the changes -> See the updated category in the list
Navigate to /categories -> Delete a category -> Confirm the deletion -> See the category removed from the list

features.name: Excel Task Table
features.description: Provides a table-based task workflow with sorting, inline editing, and Excel import/export.
user_flows: Navigate to /TasksTable -> Export tasks to Excel -> Download the spreadsheet
Navigate to /TasksTable -> Import an Excel file -> Select a .xlsx file -> See imported tasks appear in the table
Navigate to /TasksTable -> Edit timer minutes inline -> Edit execution date inline -> Toggle task completion -> See the table reflect the changes
Navigate to /TasksTable -> Sort a column -> See the task rows reorder accordingly

features.name: Profile & Statistics
features.description: Shows a user’s productivity summary, streak, charts, and activity history.
user_flows: Navigate to /profile -> Review total, completed, and active task counts -> Review the current streak and member-since date -> See the productivity summary
Navigate to /profile -> View the category distribution chart -> View the top time-consuming tasks -> View the priority chart -> View the 30-day activity heatmap

features.name: Theme Switching
features.description: Allows a visitor or user to change the app theme from the available visual themes.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open the theme selector -> Choose a theme -> See the app theme change immediately

features.name: Ambient Audio Player
features.description: Lets an authenticated user control ambient background audio from the app sidebar.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Start audio playback -> Pause playback -> Resume playback -> See the track progress update
Navigate to / -> Move to the next track -> Move to the previous track -> Adjust the volume level

features.name: Email Verification
features.description: Allows a user to verify their email through a tokenized verification page.
user_flows: Navigate to /verify-email with a verification token -> See the verification status -> Go to /login after successful verification

features.name: Admin User View
features.description: Provides an authenticated admin with a basic view of user information.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin -> View user information on the admin page

known_limitations.issue: Email validation hook blocks all real registrations (requires @example.com)
deleteTasksCompleted deletes ALL users completed tasks (no userId filter)

known_limitations.impact: Unauthenticated users can briefly access protected routes

known_limitations.issue: Timer sync is client-side only, no cross-tab synchronization
Admin page is minimal, ADMIN role shows skeleton on main page
NEXTAUTH_SECRET/NEXTAUTH_URL in .env.example are from old NextAuth.js setup
